# Shipping services

Northstar Market ships orders from its Lagos fulfilment hub from Monday through Saturday. Service estimates begin when an order is handed to the carrier, not when the customer adds it to a basket. Addresses, payment clearance, weather, and carrier capacity can affect the actual arrival date. Customers receive a dispatch email with a tracking link once a parcel leaves the hub.

## Standard delivery

Standard Lagos delivery takes 2 to 4 business days after dispatch. Standard delivery to other eligible Nigerian cities takes 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. Orders above NGN 75,000 qualify for free standard delivery when every item is in stock and the delivery address is within the listed service area. The free-delivery threshold does not convert a standard shipment into express service. Customers may still choose a paid express option where it is offered.

## Express delivery

Express Lagos delivery costs NGN 4,500 per order and normally arrives on the next business day after dispatch. Express service is available only for eligible Lagos postcodes and orders submitted before the daily dispatch cutoff. Express delivery is never free under the standard-delivery threshold policy, including for orders above NGN 75,000. Carrier availability may prevent express service from appearing at checkout for oversized or regulated items.

## Dispatch cutoff and address changes

Completed orders placed before 2 PM on an open business day are normally dispatched that day. Completed orders placed at or after 2 PM are normally dispatched on the next open business day. A customer may request an address correction before the dispatch email is issued. After dispatch, the carrier controls delivery changes and Northstar Market cannot promise a reroute.

## Exceptions

Business days exclude Sundays and published warehouse closure dates. A shipment delayed by a carrier scan does not automatically qualify for a refund. Support should review the tracking history before offering a remedy. Delivery estimates are not promises of a particular arrival time, and they do not apply to supplier-preorder items with separately stated lead times.

## Order-state checks

Shipping estimates apply only after a completed order is handed to a carrier. An order can be paid, pending payment review, awaiting stock, or already dispatched; those states have different implications. A customer who asks how long delivery takes should be told the relevant service estimate only when the service and destination are known. Support should not convert a warehouse dispatch date into a carrier arrival promise. It should also avoid assuming that a standard-delivery threshold applies to wholesale, supplier-preorder, or regulated-item orders.

## Evidence boundaries

This policy governs shipping services, dispatch timing, and delivery charges. It does not decide refund eligibility, bank settlement, product compatibility, or points earned. If a question combines delivery with another policy, each factual part must be supported by its own approved excerpt. Carrier tracking can clarify a particular shipment, but this general policy is not a substitute for a live tracking record. Any exception to a listed service must be documented separately rather than inferred from a customer's order value alone.
